claim_text: Python 3.13 provides a build configuration that can disable the global interpreter lock.

evidence.passage: As of Python 3.13, the GIL can be disabled using the --disable-gil build configuration.
evidence.provenance_basis: Official publisher-hosted document observed; underlying reporting-chain independence has not been established.

evidence.passage: This PEP proposes adding a build configuration (--disable-gil) to CPython to let it run Python code without the global interpreter lock
evidence.source_title: PEP 703 – Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython
evidence.provenance_basis: Documented common topic or institutional program; shared underlying origin may exist and independence is not verified.
